history: Initial full run: male three cases passed; female three cases failed because formatted registration exceeded the existing 1 MiB loader limit. Compact serialization and exact asset rebinding fixed this without changing pixels.

Female rerun: comparison and roundtrip passed; export UI and independent player completed, but the offline audit incorrectly compared a broad hand/sleeve review polygon directly to bare source. Diagnostic: 471 raw differences already existed in accepted baseline (470 sleeve pixels, one hair-edge pixel); actual before/after changes were zero.

Audit now preserves the full actual hand/sleeve baseline, asserts true registered opaque hand pixels equal source, and retains exact ownership/protection checks. The female export case was rerun and passed; all 18 project/pack/PNG/GIF inputs checked remain byte-identical to the earlier actual exports used for review.
offlineScope: The existing roundtrip test blocks appearance/clothing bank downloads after loading the workbench; it proves embedded-project reopening and exact resaving. It does not claim an uncached application can bootstrap without a network.
